title: Zora: dam, receiving bank, Princess and return
status: Room-building proof; BG2 floor/mask and landing review pending
notes: This review keeps the complete loaded Room26 and Room27 renders beneath annotations. DeepAudit retains room authorship.

Human geometry feedback: the dark retaining contour is a useful room-building proof. The landing is tight, BG2 masking and authored floor treatment need refinement, and the Princess final location is unselected.
Open the separately pinned corrected LOW or HIGH private ROM. Steps filter annotations only: they do not switch ROMs, raise water, operate the dam or prove a route.
Persistent LOW-to-HIGH intent remains proposed. This bank is a proof of room construction, not a definitive Princess location or a completed hydraulic implementation.
Princess, Link and Baby staging coordinates from the previous wider deck have been removed. Future placement must reserve approach, chest-front and stair landing space together.
All paths and connection envelopes are proposed intentions, not measured free floor, safe collision masks or controller-qualified travel.
The image underneath is the current loaded room model, not an immutable before snapshot. Use the separately bound full-room PNGs for the frozen comparison.
Exact ROM, image, source and overlay hashes are in the external ZORA_REVIEW_BINDING.json. Version1 does not validate those bindings or load native receipts.
